# Canonical terminology

Use these terms consistently when describing the public repository.

| Canonical term | Meaning | Do not replace with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vibe-mathing-cn` | The public project and repository identity | an unnamed AI theorem prover |
| trusted AI mathematics research and verification workbench | The project category | universal solver, autonomous mathematician |
| Point–Line–Face–Body (`PLFB`) | The single conceptual metamodel root: object, typed relation, bounded dimension, and reference-only composition | one model among several parallel roots |
| `PWTSJ` / Face F05 | Process model `Project → Workflow → Task → Step → Job` | the whole Vibe Math metamodel |
| `OSPS` / Face F04 | Outcome-space model for OutcomeNodes, Obligations, alternatives, and the search frontier | a Job scheduler, evidence issuer, or Result authority |
| `Body` | Reference-only composition of Faces and cross-face Lines | a copied second truth source |
| `ProblemContract` | Versioned input contract for statement, domain, quantifiers, assumptions, sources, acceptance, and constraints; the specification/semantics boundary | an informal prompt |
| `CandidateObservation` | Source-discovery input kept outside research admission | a verified problem |
| `Attempt` | Traceable research activity with methods, tools, artifacts, failures, and lifecycle | a proof or a solved problem |
| `Result` | Scoped atomic claim with separate outcome and evidence capabilities | any model-generated answer |
| `ResearchBundle` | Read-only derived view of one problem's current facts and obligations | a fourth writable ledger |
| `Solution View` | Derived index of Results that satisfy complete admission | a manually curated answer list |
| public ProblemContract catalog | External discovery/admission index for concrete problem repositories | this repository's local canonical ledger |
| Web research template | Fixed single-problem Harness source used by concrete repositories | a mathematical verifier or Result store |
| method-layer map | Specification & Semantics → Deductive Verification → Model Checking → Abstract Interpretation → SAT/SMT/Symbolic Reasoning (including Symbolic Execution) → Refinement/Synthesis; Lean is in the deductive branch | a Lean tutorial table of contents as the whole field |
| top-level lifecycle | Inside F05: Project → Workflow → Task → Step → Job; Job is one bounded Step execution and is orthogonal to Outcome/Evidence/Result state | a successful Job or completed Attempt as a solved mathematical problem |
| freshness authority | local canonical ledgers and `solutions.json` decide local status; external catalog values are dated snapshots requiring revalidation | verified date as a guarantee of future freshness |
| `open` | Honest disposition when no accepted proof or counterexample closes the problem | failure, solved, or refuted |

Always state that finite computation, passing tests, proof drafts, self-review, and source labels are not by themselves mathematical proof or Result admission.
